regime_filter: Do not trade if 5M range_over_mean is below recent baseline AND 5M vol is low. This is compression.
Require minimum slope magnitude on 5M. Tiny slopes are noise even if aligned.
Only classify as trend if slope magnitude AND volatility are both meaningful.
If 5M and 30M slopes align but volatility is contracting, do not treat as trend.
direction_rules: Trade only in direction of strongest timeframe alignment.
If 5M slope is very small but 30M large, wait for pullback or expansion.
Do not buy at local highs after 2+ consecutive expansion candles.
Do not sell at local lows after 2+ consecutive expansion candles.
structure_rules: Entry must be near recent micro-structure: pullback to prior break level or small consolidation edge.
Avoid entries in middle of recent 5M range.
Avoid entries directly into recent swing high or swing low.
There must be visible room to next structural level.
volatility_rules: Require stable or expanding 5M volatility for continuation trades.
Do not trade when 5M volatility is below session average.
Avoid trading immediately after abnormal spike without structure.
stop_loss_rules: Stop must be beyond structural invalidation (last higher low / lower high).
Stop distance must not be smaller than typical 5M candle body.
take_profit_rules: Target must be next structural liquidity level.
R multiple should normally fall within realistic intraday range.
If required target implies extreme expansion beyond recent volatility, skip trade.
risk_rules: High risk only when slope magnitude, volatility expansion, and structure all align strongly.
Moderate risk when structure is good but volatility moderate.
Low risk when minor alignment or counter-move within larger regime.
Do not use similar risk repeatedly; adjust based on structural clarity.
participation_control: No trade is better than low-quality trade.
If regime unclear after short waiting window, skip instead of forcing entry.
Do not trade compression expecting expansion without breakout confirmation.
